ruleDefinitions.name: Password Protected ZIP File Opened (Suspicious Filenames)
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the extraction of password protected ZIP archives with suspicious file names. See the filename variable for more details on which file has been opened. Note: Unmapped fields: TargetName

sequences.query: (event_id = 5379 AND TargetName = RGX(".*Microsoft\\_Windows\\_Shell\\_ZipFolder\\:filename.*")) AND (TargetName = RGX(".*invoice.*") OR TargetName = RGX(".*new\\ order.*") OR TargetName = RGX(".*rechnung.*") OR TargetName = RGX(".*factura.*") OR TargetName = RGX(".*delivery.*") OR TargetName = RGX(".*purchase.*") OR TargetName = RGX(".*order.*") OR TargetName = RGX(".*payment.*"))
